single_hypothesis: Point-in-time BitMEX XBTUSD forced-liquidation bursts contain incremental information, beyond frozen Bybit structural distances, about whether Bybit BTCUSDT reaches upper or lower external liquidity first.
smc_ict_translation: BitMEX forced deleveraging raids liquidity. The model distinguishes Bybit displacement acceptance and same-side delivery from sweep exhaustion, reclaim and opposing-liquidity delivery.

source_contract.source_gap_rule: unavailable entry is rejected; an accepted unresolved position pays the full structural stop

event_contract.burst_grouping: all XBTUSD liquidation rows separated by no more than two seconds; one row may form a burst
event_contract.burst_availability: two-second quiet interval after the last row
event_contract.entry: first Bybit BTCUSDT BBO at or after the delayed request, maximum additional delay two seconds
event_contract.structure: four-hour pre-burst Bybit BBO-mid range frozen before the burst
event_contract.label: upper versus lower executable pool first passage
event_contract.ambiguous_touch: adverse and unavailable as a favorable training label

minimal_ml_contract.calibration: one frozen isotonic probability map learned only on the calibration dates
features: signed liquidation amount divided by prior BitMEX turnover
liquidation pace divided by prior BitMEX turnover rate
BitMEX delayed price impact per forced-flow share
BitMEX-Bybit relative response residual divided by prior relative volatility
minimal_ml_contract.decision: one cost-adjusted LONG/SHORT/FLAT expected-value equation at 18 bp

account_contract.top_10_percent_winner_counterfactual: remove event keys before slot competition and rerun the whole account

survivor_obligation: continuous exact Bybit reconstruction, actual funding, broader capacity and causal 2023 evidence before any official 2024 opening
